description: Log as-needed medication and see your patterns. Offline, no accounts PillMate is for medication you take when you need it, not on a fixed schedule. Log each dose with one tap, then see your own pattern: when you take it, how much, and how far apart. It is not an alarm-based pill reminder. Reminders exist, but they are optional. Features • One-tap dose logging, with home-screen widget and quick-log notification • Daily 24-hour clock, weekly view and statistics with calculated insights • Optional reminders • Photos of your medication and encrypted voice notes • Optional lock with fingerprint or face (checked by Android) • Backup to ZIP, CSV and PDF export, always to a place you choose Privacy • No internet permission: the app cannot connect to any server • No accounts, no analytics, no ads, no trackers • All data stays on your device • Free software, GPL-3.0-or-later PillMate records what you write down; it gives no medical advice and is not a medical device.
